# tplinkrouter_vlan (Data Source)

VLAN switching membership; configure routed addressing with a separate interface resource.

## 范围与行为

- 分类：Network。
- SLP 读取对象：`vlan.vlan`。
- 管理页面证据：`/userrpm/vlan_setting.htm`。
- 只读查询，不修改运行配置，也不执行保存。秘密写入字段不暴露为读取属性。
- 返回全部匹配条目；筛选由此类型固定的设备接口约束决定，无通用 JSON 输入或选择器。

Available only when the device exposes the vlan.vlan table. VLAN 1 cannot be deleted. A routed VLAN interface is a separate interface resource; create the VLAN before its interface and destroy the interface first.
